Luxembourg Deputy PM Visits India to Boost Bilateral Relations

Luxembourg's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister, Xavier Bettel, arrived in India on September 7 for a three-day visit. During his stay, which concludes on September 9, Bettel is scheduled to meet with India's External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar in Delhi. The visit aims to strengthen bilateral ties between India and Luxembourg. Bettel is also expected to visit Chennai, including IIT Madras and the new SES campus.
